$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Shape maths
blocks.for: Area and winding, the box round some rings with its width and height, point-in-shape, distances and crossings, move, rotate, mirror, simplify and centre rings and islands, nest loose rings or font contours into islands, and the widest point inside a shape.

blocks.name: Basic outlines
blocks.for: Rings for the everyday shapes: circles, rectangles (rounded, placed by their centre), slots, stars, regular polygons, hexagons, arcs, teardrops and dog tags, and any polygon with its corners rounded.

internal.why: The pattern engine's own small helpers (a box's centre, its chord count for a circle, a two-point line) and its order of summing a ring's area, which came here with its geometry so its fills stay bit-identical. Not blocks of their own.
